tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image with OpenAI image generation and save it into the project. Takes up to a few minutes. Use this for ALL image creation: illustrations, logos, icons, photos, mockup images, pictures of diagrams. Never draw images by hand in code when this tool fits. Returns the saved file path.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit or restyle existing images with OpenAI image generation (takes up to a few minutes): change one element, swap a background, combine references. Use this for ALL image edits. Returns the saved file path.

tools.name: daybreak
tools.description: Hand security work to OpenAI Daybreak through Codex: vulnerability review, secure code review, threat modeling, dependency risk, validating a security fix. It reads the project read-only, can take several minutes, and returns its findings. Works only on turns the user approved for Daybreak.
